adversarialCases.scenario: A job has status success but its CSV artifact is missing after completion.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The row is not silently openable; it reports artifact_missing/success_without_openable_artifact and exposes recover_result plus rerun_same_condition.

adversarialCases.scenario: The result library contains many cancelled rows with no openable artifacts.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Detail buttons remain disabled, but rerun buttons are enabled so the library is not a dead cancelled-only trap.

adversarialCases.contractRef: Recoverable/problem states require explicit user action
adversarialCases.scenario: An error/cancelled/stale/recoverable job has an artifact or action taxonomy.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: It does not auto-open; manual open/recover/report/rerun actions are shown according to open_actions.

adversarialCases.contractRef: no_trades is a valid empty result
adversarialCases.scenario: A terminal job completes with no trades and no CSV.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The detail auto-opens with available true, metrics null, and empty analysis instead of an error.

adversarialCases.scenario: A legacy job/generation record has names but no captured buy_code/sell_code snapshots.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: It remains displayable as name_only_legacy with low confidence and never masquerades as a high-confidence current DB code hash.

adversarialCases.contractRef: Generation and demo /bt/result additive field shape
adversarialCases.scenario: A consumer requests /bt/result for generation CSV-present, metrics-only, or demo sources.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Available branches include source_type, evidence_id, condition_identity, status_kind, artifact_state, openable, recoverable, open_actions, and rerun_spec while preserving existing fields.

adversarialCases.scenario: Phase 1 is implemented before shared ResultDetail/History/IA/editor/replay work.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: No later-phase UI ownership migration is introduced before G001 checkpoint.
